name: Ironcap Archers
headerMeta: Chivalric era · Ranged Infantry · special · 110 leadership · T2 · Mastery

origin.text: Honor Tree unit - part of a combined build guide with Vassal Longbowmen, Imperial Archers, and Vanguard Archer.

pitch: A cheap filler ranged unit that lags behind meta in impact. Standard archers teach poor game habits (no micro, deceptive safety, skill-stunting for new players) and force teammates to compensate — if you want range, pick exotic units instead.

doctrines.name: Bowmanship Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Arrow Rain deals 75% of the unit's base piercing DMG per hit, +150 piercing DMG.
doctrines.note: Arrow Rain +150 piercing DMG, 75% base per hit

doctrines.name: Precision Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +120 piercing DMG, +80 piercing AP, +9% rate of fire.
doctrines.note: +120 piercing DMG, +80 AP, +9% rate of fire

doctrines.name: LDS Doctrine
doctrines.note: alt for piercing DMG if needed

doctrines.name: Whistling Arrow Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Every 3 hits inflicts bleeding for 12% of target's current HP; can trigger in concert with allied units at weak points.

doctrines.name: Artemis
doctrines.effect: Unlocks Double Strings: fires 2 arrows per shot for 12s, 40s CD; can't combine with other actives except Overwatch.

veterancy.label: Damage line
veterancy.body: Standard archers fall in the DMG-boost category — go the damage line. {1}

matchups.siblings: Covered in the same combined guide as Vassal Longbowmen, Imperial Archers, and Vanguard Archer - identical playstyle argument and doctrine build across all four, tier is the only thing that's called out per unit. Ironcap Archer sits lowest of the four at T2.

controls.notes: If your veterancy line includes Arrow Rain, you cannot equip Arrow Rain doctrine — swap for extra piercing instead. {1}
